title: kith-tui: Message/query hardcodes limit=50 with no UI indication of truncation
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:331 — the Message/query request hardcodes 'limit': 50. A chat with more than 50 messages will silently display only the most recent 50 with no scroll-back and no indication to the user that history is truncated. This will generate user bug reports ('my messages are missing'). Need either pagination (load more on scroll) or a much higher limit with lazy loading.
